comment: Waited almost 4 hours. The queue system is broken.
Very fast and the staff explained everything clearly. Thank you!
Ang tagal ng proseso, pabalik-balik ako ng tatlong beses.
The guard was rude to senior citizens in line.
Okay naman, medyo mainit lang sa loob.
I lost my receipt and they still helped me. Great service.
Website said the office opens at 8 but it opened at 9:30.
Someone asked me for extra money to speed up my papers.
Clean office, short line, done in 20 minutes.
The printer was broken so I had to come back tomorrow. Sayang ang pamasahe.
Friendly staff pero kulang ang upuan sa waiting area.
